tool_input.command:

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(ABS(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  AVG(ABS(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  AVG(ABS(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  AVG(ABS(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  AVG(ABS(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad_f5,

  CORR(t.f2,s.f2) AS corr_f2,
  CORR(t.f3,s.f3) AS corr_f3,
  CORR(t.f4,s.f4) AS corr_f4,

FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.training_sample\` t
JOIN \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.serving_log\` s USING(entity_id)
"

tool_input.content:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(ABS(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  AVG(ABS(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  AVG(ABS(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  AVG(ABS(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  AVG(ABS(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad_f5,
  CORR(t.f1,s.f1) AS corr_f1,
  CORR(t.f2,s.f2) AS corr_f2,
  CORR(t.f3,s.f3) AS corr_f3,
  CORR(t.f4,s.f4) AS corr_f4,
  CORR(t.f5,s.f5) AS corr_f5
FROM mlpab_mlpab5a918e.training_sample t
JOIN mlpab_mlpab5a918e.serving_log s USING(entity_id)

SELECT
  t.entity_id,
  t.f2 AS train_f2,
  s.f2 AS serve_f2,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(s.f2, t.f2) AS ratio,
  s.f2 - t.f2 AS diff
FROM mlpab_mlpab5a918e.training_sample t
JOIN mlpab_mlpab5a918e.serving_log s USING(entity_id)
ORDER BY t.entity_id
LIMIT 12

SELECT
  MAX(ABS(t.f2 - LN(1 + s.f2)))            AS max_err_log1p_serve,
  MAX(ABS(s.f2 - (EXP(t.f2) - 1)))         AS max_err_expm1_train,
  MAX(ABS(t.f2 - LN(s.f2)))                AS max_err_ln_serve
FROM mlpab_mlpab5a918e.training_sample t
JOIN mlpab_mlpab5a918e.serving_log s USING(entity_id)
